BRYANT – Thur Aug.13 Fri Aug 14 Sat Aug 15 – 8 am till 12noon. Yard sales 8am till 12 noon 700 Martin ln Bryant Reynolds rd “Water Guns, Pokémon Toys
And more.”

BRYANT – August 13-14-15, 8am to 12noon Yard sales 700 Martin Ln Bryant Off Reynolds rd and Griffis rd Toys, Pokémon, pallet jack

ALEXANDER NORTH – Friday & Sat August 21st & 22nd at 7:00 multi family yard sale 7301 Lequieu Lane alexander Off Springhill and/or Hwy 5 Furniture, adult clothes,golf clubs,shoes, purses

ALEXANDER – August 21st & 22nd 7:00 Yard sale 7201 lequieu lane Alexander Off Hwy 5 and/or Springhill Furniture, Adult clothes, shoes, purses, golf clubs and household items

BENTON – Sat Aug 22 Moving/Yard Sale 2248 Centennial Valley Dr Benton Furniture, toddler boy clothes, kitchen items, toddler toys

ALEXANDER SOUTH – Saturday Oct. 15, 2026 630 am- 10:30 am Yard Sale 16011 Autumn Cove Alexander St. Joseph Glen Subdivision Adult Clothes, Furniture, school items, formal dresses, & more!

SUBMIT your sale for free in the form below. Please allow at least 24-48 hours before the event so a human will have time to publish it for you!

Or ADVERTISE your sale in a featured ad on our social media. Email info@mysaline.com to set it up.
